answer: A payout is split so that 47% arrives at settlement and the rest over 16 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The marble schedule is applied in umber and velvet shows each instalment. Someone hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2563 identities would post 1695 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
